meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把任意文字内容变成生动的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把文章或笔记快速变成讲解视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn any text into an engaging explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn articles or notes into explainer videos quickly

howto.what: 把用户提供的文章、笔记等文字转换成一部“无脸解说视频”：画面是排版、抽象图形、图表等虚构元素，没有真实拍摄。Claude会生成设计系统、故事板、脚本、音频元数据，最后产出HTML帧和渲染视频。
howto.when: 当用户要求把一段文字（文章、笔记、主题等）做成解说视频，且不是网站宣传片时触发；意图不明确时先转 /hyperframes 判断。

howto.what_en: Turns user-provided text (article, notes, topic) into a faceless explainer video: visuals are invented (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams), no real footage. Claude produces design system, storyboard, script, audio metadata, HTML frames, and a rendered video.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to turn a block of text (article, notes, topic) into an explainer video, not a website promo. If intent is unclear, it routes via /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into a 3-minute explainer video.
